audit_cautions: All 13 generation manifests report codex-cli 0.152.0, whereas the protocol named 0.151.0-alpha.7.2. Record a version deviation; do not assume equivalence or silently update the preregistration.

versions:none and resolver backtracking alone do not prove a network failure. Earlier retries based on those symptoms have uncertain protocol eligibility; keep first outcomes and sensitivity analyses.
The mode=online execution flag records intended disclosure, not proof that an Agent received it. Branch prompt and trajectory evidence must establish actual disclosure.
Metric pass means bootstrap exit 0 and official issuesCount 0 with a report. It does not independently establish candidate admissibility, deployment completeness, or replay robustness.
errorCount, token totals, frontier trajectories, and weak-baseline difficulty labels cannot replace the primary terminal endpoint.
Model-free wrapper agreement on four fixtures did not establish repeated package resolution or program-outcome stability.

machine_use.Mac: Authenticated controller for 7 P0, 6 A2, and 12 F/N continuations; local artifact collection and analysis.
machine_use.AgentHub: Remote construction containers for all 13 P0/A2 episodes. Two simultaneous construction containers were observed; completed experiment containers have been removed by the runner.
machine_use.Spark: Sole candidate executor for all 44 pilot executions, serially scored to avoid contention.
machine_use.AgentHub_limit: No more than two construction jobs; the last pair reached about 7.9 GiB free. This is a capacity constraint, not an algorithmic feature.

scientific_conclusion.main_contradiction: No verified strong-Agent online semantic failures in this selected batch, while identical-program terminal outcomes vary.
scientific_conclusion.strongest_support_for_problem: python-control has an observed postepisode missing-import failure despite an online score-pass for identical program bytes.
scientific_conclusion.strongest_counterevidence: Five initial online executions and a sixth retry score-pass; every F program is unchanged from P0. The selected weak-baseline-enriched cases do not expose a feedback repair opportunity.
scientific_conclusion.alternative_explanation: External delivery noise and unresolved executor/package-state variation can create apparent arm differences without any algorithmic improvement.
scientific_conclusion.decision: Retain the minimal replay hypothesis as unproven, close historical v7 without promotion, keep Live frontier killed, and do not enter protected or representative treatment evaluation.
scientific_conclusion.next: Propose a fixed-program repeatability diagnostic, followed by an independently selected Dev strong-Agent P0 census. Do not start either from this closeout.
